# Brimwood Innovation

> Build a business. Build yourself.

Brimwood Innovation is a selective innovation hub in Toronto for ambitious
people building AI-powered micro businesses. Membership is by invitation or
referral only. Standard: "Elite by effort, not by background."

## Site

- Home: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/: what Brimwood is, the four promises, how it works, introduction request form
- About: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/about/: story, the standard, the hub, weekly rhythm, what we are not
- Blog: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/blog/: notes on micro business, AI in practice, owner mindset
- Events: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/events/: demo nights and gatherings, with RSVP
- Invite: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/invite/: redeem an invitation to join
- Search: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/search/: search blog posts, lessons, and pages
- Newsletter: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/newsletter/: signup (double opt-in), email-exclusive archive
- Privacy: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/privacy/
- Terms: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/terms/
- Services: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/: all 17 services across five pillars (Build, Automate, Grow, Create, Guide). Lead services: Custom automation and Website plus lead engine. Every engagement starts with an introduction; scope and price are agreed in writing before work starts. No public price list.
- Build pillar: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/build/: websites and lead engines, web development, custom software and tools
- Automate pillar: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/automate/: custom automation, conversational AI agents
- Grow pillar: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/grow/: search and AI visibility, paid ads management and creative, warm-lead capture, local community growth
- Create pillar: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/create/: social media support (VSMM), brand film, TVC and broadcast commercials, 2D and 3D animation and explainer videos, graphic design, content day retainer
- Guide pillar: https://brimwoodinnovation.com/services/guide/: founder consultancy and planning, design, build, and strategy

## Facts

- Location: 1365 Gerrard St E Unit 2, Toronto, Canada
- Contact: info@brimwoodinnovation.com
- Rhythm: Monday Commit, Wednesday Forge, Friday Show + dine, monthly public demos
- Content pillars: micro business (30%), AI in practice (30%), owner mindset (20%), members + hub (20%)

## Voice

Canadian spelling. Short sentences. No income promises, no hype language,
no "10x" claims. Members are anonymous by default, share the what, never
the how, unless written permission was given.
